note: Irregularities found while registering the five submitted links. Published for owner review; none of them blocks a merge, and none has been silently fixed. Each row states what was measured, what it does and does not establish, and the source it came from.

rows.title: Two of the five submitted links resolve to a different product category than the other three
rows.measured: SUB-01..SUB-03 resolve into Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Small Appliances > Fryers > Air Fryers. SUB-04 and SUB-05 resolve into Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets > Thermometers & Timers > Meat.
rows.what_it_establishes: The five links do not point at one product category. Any page that describes the promoted set as air fryers would be wrong about two of the five.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that the two thermometer links were submitted in error, nor that the owner intended a single-category site. Intent is unconfirmed for all five (IF-03).
rows.suggested_owner_action: Confirm whether the two thermometer links belong in this project, then choose IP-02.

rows.title: No resolved URL carries an Associates tag, so none of the five is established as a Special Link
rows.measured: Every resolved URL carries lv, btn_type, gaOptInStatus, btn_ref, channelId and plpRedirect. None carries tag=. Amazon's own help page publishes the format as amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID (IN-03) and the Operating Agreement requires links to 'properly use the special tagged link formats we provide' (IN-01).
rows.what_it_establishes: The tag parameter is absent from all five observed destinations.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that the links are invalid or non-compliant. A tag may be attached server-side during the redirect in a way this measurement cannot see, which is exactly why the brief's FLG-003 treats their compliance status as unresolved. This project does not claim either way.
rows.suggested_owner_action: Test one link from an enrolled Associates account and read the tracking report before scaling, as the brief requires.

rows.title: Intended ASIN is unconfirmed for all five submissions
rows.measured: Each submitted token is 9 characters. Amazon's help page defines an ASIN as 'the 10-digit code that Amazon uses to denote specific products' (IN-03). No public Amazon document binds a short code to a destination ASIN.
rows.what_it_establishes: The four intent fields on every row are legitimately blank.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that the observed destinations are wrong. They are reproducible; they are simply not proven to be what was meant.
rows.suggested_owner_action: Confirm the intended ASIN and official listing URL from Associates Central or a Creators API lookup, then fill the intent fields.

rows.title: The submitted set grew from three links to five, and the repository's registers did not
rows.measured: Before this session, a search of every tracked file returned no occurrence of B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj or shopnow047c-20. The product register, the README's 'three supplied links' section and the resolved-destination tables are all built around three.
rows.what_it_establishes: Every published statement of the form 'the three supplied links' is now incomplete by two.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that any published statement about the original three is wrong.
rows.suggested_owner_action: Choose IP-01. The other registers are owned by finished sessions, so this namespace records the gap rather than editing them.

rows.title: The control 404 is served from amzlinks.in, and no official Amazon page confirms who operates that host
rows.measured: Requesting an unissued code resolves the 404 page at https://amzlinks.in/B0c8moW5Z with the text 'Uh oh, it looks like something went wrong. You've clicked on an invalid URL.'
rows.what_it_establishes: The short-link service's error page is served from a non-amazon.com domain.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish who operates that host, or whether the service is Amazon's. Third-party write-ups exist and are not official sources, so this project records the observation and leaves the question open. Whether these are Amazon-issued links matters to IP-03.
rows.suggested_owner_action: Answer IQ-05, ideally from Associates Central where the links were generated.

rows.title: The two observation passes for SUB-04 and SUB-05 are not fully independent
rows.measured: OBS-07 returned the same Amazon session id (134-4510030-8424149) and the same btn_ref as OBS-05; OBS-08 likewise matched OBS-06 (132-4435338-5192244).
rows.what_it_establishes: Both passes resolved to the same ASIN and the same page title.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish stability across independent sessions. That is why observation_count is reported with this caveat rather than being presented as N independent confirmations.
rows.suggested_owner_action: None required; recorded so a reader does not over-read the count.

rows.title: shopnow047c-20 is recorded as submitted, with no attribute attached
rows.measured: The brief names it as the selected tracking ID. No official page was found that defines this identifier, confirms it is an Associates tracking ID, or links it to a marketplace or account.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that it is a valid Associates tracking ID, which marketplace it belongs to, or that it is the tag the links will use.

rows.title: The self-hosted analytics endpoint the brief asks for cannot run on this host
rows.measured: GitHub's own documentation states: 'GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that takes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files straight from a repository on GitHub' (IN-16). This site is published by GitHub Pages.
rows.what_it_establishes: There is no place on this host to run server-side code, so a self-hosted endpoint that receives beacons and writes them to a store cannot be deployed here.
rows.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not establish that measurement is impossible. It establishes that the measurement decision (IP-04) must be taken before any of it is built, because the options differ in what they cost and what they can store.
rows.suggested_owner_action: Choose IP-04 before writing tracking code.
